notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are absent.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description is absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, and tags are editable; description and note are absent.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected, but the user is not guided or taken to edit the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: The list exposes title and tags, but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag-entry autocomplete is not implemented.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and URL, but not description or note.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: Multi-selection and bulk actions are absent.
REF-BM-21: Filter-scoped whole-collection bulk actions are absent.
REF-BM-22: Results have a fixed newest-first order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are absent.
